evidenceSeparation.localExecutable: validator proves draft completeness and linkage only
evidenceSeparation.serverDependent: Track 6B must run every drill against a fixed RC and retain raw evidence
evidenceSeparation.humanDependent: named incident commander, on-call acceptance, escalation contacts and customer/legal response require approval

incidents.title: Authorization or cross-Space disclosure
incidents.detect: A current authorization predicate, BOLA sentinel or object-read check permits an unexpected actor.
readOnlyDiagnosis: preserve request IDs and policy versions
identify actor and resource binding hashes
inspect cache and object lookup order without opening unrelated content
containment: revoke affected session or capability families
freeze related writes when relationship integrity is uncertain
recovery: restore reads only after negative BOLA replay
incidents.escalation: Security, service owner, privacy owner and release controller

incidents.title: Upload, object or derivative checksum mismatch
incidents.detect: Observed bytes, checksum, MIME, decoder output or committed item count diverges.
readOnlyDiagnosis: compare receipt and object hashes
identify decoder and policy versions
find visible references without reading unrelated media
recovery: write a new derivative provenance record
resume uploads after mismatch injection passes
reconciliation: match object, database and receipt hashes
verify no stale derivative remains visible
incidents.escalation: Media, API, security and release owners

incidents.title: Panorama current-revision invariant failure
incidents.detect: Active panorama, revision, asset and audit event no longer describe one atomic current scene.
readOnlyDiagnosis: compare active rows and CAS versions
verify panorama asset hashes
inspect switch event and current projection
reconciliation: prove one current revision per Space
verify Viewer returns the restored revision
incidents.escalation: Panorama, API, Viewer and release owners

incidents.title: Locator queue or retry storm
incidents.detect: Locator or Book Lab job age, retry or dead-letter rate exceeds its approved bounded policy.
readOnlyDiagnosis: split queue by job kind and build
inspect oldest immutable input
compare dependency health and retry class
containment: stop only new affected job kinds
preserve manual placement and Core upload
reconciliation: prove no duplicate placement or artifact
incidents.escalation: Affected worker owner and release controller

incidents.title: Revoke-first deletion or CDN denial failure
incidents.detect: Deleted or revoked content remains readable, or its ledger and row versions diverge.
readOnlyDiagnosis: verify denial overlay and authorization state
inspect deletion event chain
compare object and CDN disposition
recovery: retry purge and object cleanup idempotently
do not mutate old ledger events
incidents.escalation: Security, API, media delivery, data operations and privacy owners

incidents.title: Backup, restore or release-state mismatch
incidents.detect: Backup age exceeds target or an isolated restore differs from expected metadata, objects, authorization or ledger state.
readOnlyDiagnosis: compare backup and deploy manifests
verify schema and composite foreign keys
inspect deletion and revocation ledger heads
containment: stop new authority and writes when recoverability is uncertain
recovery: replay revocation and deletion before traffic
roll back only to a CAS-safe writer
reconciliation: prove hidden and deleted content did not revive
measure actual RPO and RTO without changing targets
incidents.escalation: Data operations, security, service owners and release controller

incidents.title: Media decoder crash or resource exhaustion
incidents.detect: The isolated decoder crashes, times out or exceeds byte, pixel, frame, metadata, CPU, memory or wall-time limits.
readOnlyDiagnosis: record fixture and decoder build hashes
inspect resource-limit result
verify quarantine and visible count
containment: do not fall back to first-frame acceptance
recovery: resume only after isolation limits pass
reconciliation: prove no visible Photo or derivative was created

incidents.title: Secret-redaction canary finding
incidents.detect: A runtime-generated synthetic marker appears in any declared server, edge, analytics, trace, crash, metric or browser sink.
readOnlyDiagnosis: identify sink and route class
compare observable schema and redaction build
never reproduce with a live credential
containment: revoke affected authority if exposure is possible
recovery: remove the marker from every sink
fix redaction at the shared boundary
repeat with a newly generated marker
reconciliation: prove every declared sink is clean
verify no raw URL, IP, agent or identifier remains
incidents.escalation: Security, privacy, observability and release controller
